title: PDFium API Specification
description: External specification for PDFium P/Invoke function signatures used for validation. This file defines expected return types, parameters, calling conventions, and marshaling notes for critical PDFium functions.

functions.name: FPDF_InitLibrary
functions.marshalingNotes: No parameters. Must be called before using PDFium library.

functions.name: FPDF_DestroyLibrary
functions.marshalingNotes: No parameters. Must be called after all PDFium resources are released.

functions.name: FPDF_LoadDocument

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.marshalingNotes: UTF-8 encoded string, null-terminated. Use MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStr) for ANSI or convert to byte[] for UTF-8.

parameters.name: password
parameters.marshalingNotes: UTF-8 encoded password, null-terminated. Can be null if document is not encrypted.

functions.marshalingNotes: Returns FPDF_DOCUMENT handle (IntPtr). Returns IntPtr.Zero on failure.

functions.name: FPDF_LoadMemDocument

parameters.name: data_buf
parameters.marshalingNotes: Raw PDF data buffer. Use byte[] with automatic marshaling.

parameters.name: size
parameters.marshalingNotes: Size of data_buf in bytes. Must match actual buffer length.

parameters.name: password
parameters.marshalingNotes: UTF-8 encoded password, null-terminated. Can be null if document is not encrypted.

functions.marshalingNotes: Loads PDF from memory buffer. Returns FPDF_DOCUMENT handle or IntPtr.Zero on failure.

functions.name: FPDF_CloseDocument

parameters.name: document
parameters.marshalingNotes: FPDF_DOCUMENT handle from FPDF_LoadDocument or FPDF_LoadMemDocument.

functions.marshalingNotes: Closes and releases document resources. Handle becomes invalid after this call.

functions.name: FPDF_GetPageCount
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns number of pages in document. Returns 0 for invalid document.

functions.name: FPDF_LoadPage

parameters.name: page_index
parameters.marshalingNotes: Zero-based page index. Must be < FPDF_GetPageCount.

functions.marshalingNotes: Returns FPDF_PAGE handle or IntPtr.Zero on failure.

functions.name: FPDF_ClosePage
functions.marshalingNotes: Closes and releases page resources. Handle becomes invalid after this call.

functions.name: FPDF_GetPageWidth
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns page width in points. May return 0 for invalid page. Legacy integer-based API.

functions.name: FPDF_GetPageHeight
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns page height in points. May return 0 for invalid page. Legacy integer-based API.

functions.name: FPDF_GetPageWidthF
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns page width in points as float. Preferred over FPDF_GetPageWidth. May return 0 or invalid value on some PDFium versions (workaround needed).

functions.name: FPDF_GetPageHeightF
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns page height in points as float. Preferred over FPDF_GetPageHeight. May return 0 or invalid value on some PDFium versions (workaround needed).

functions.name: FPDFBitmap_Create

parameters.name: width
parameters.marshalingNotes: Bitmap width in pixels. Must be > 0.

parameters.name: height
parameters.marshalingNotes: Bitmap height in pixels. Must be > 0.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.marshalingNotes: 0 for no alpha, 1 for alpha. Affects pixel format (BGR vs BGRA).

functions.marshalingNotes: Creates bitmap buffer. Returns FPDF_BITMAP handle or IntPtr.Zero on failure. Caller must destroy with FPDFBitmap_Destroy.

functions.name: FPDFBitmap_Destroy
functions.marshalingNotes: Destroys bitmap and releases resources. Handle becomes invalid after this call.

functions.name: FPDFBitmap_GetBuffer
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns pointer to bitmap buffer. Use with Marshal.Copy to read pixel data. Buffer size = stride * height.

functions.name: FPDFBitmap_GetStride
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns stride (bytes per row) for bitmap. May include padding. Use checked arithmetic for stride * height to prevent overflow.

functions.name: FPDF_RenderPageBitmap

parameters.name: start_x
parameters.marshalingNotes: X offset in pixels for rendering.

parameters.name: start_y
parameters.marshalingNotes: Y offset in pixels for rendering.

functions.marshalingNotes: Renders page into bitmap buffer. No return value. Check bitmap buffer after call.

functions.name: FPDFBookmark_GetTitle

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.marshalingNotes: UTF-16LE buffer for bookmark title. Use two-phase allocation: pass null to get required size, then allocate and call again.

parameters.name: buflen
parameters.marshalingNotes: Buffer size in bytes. Must be multiple of 2 for UTF-16LE.

functions.marshalingNotes: Returns required buffer size in bytes (including null terminator) if buffer is null. Returns actual bytes written if buffer is provided. UTF-16LE encoding with null terminator.

functions.name: FPDFBookmark_GetFirstChild

parameters.name: bookmark
parameters.marshalingNotes: Parent FPDF_BOOKMARK handle or IntPtr.Zero for root bookmarks.

functions.marshalingNotes: Returns first child bookmark or IntPtr.Zero if none exist.

functions.name: FPDFBookmark_GetNextSibling
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns next sibling bookmark or IntPtr.Zero if no more siblings.

functions.name: FPDFText_LoadPage
functions.marshalingNotes: Loads text page for text extraction. Returns FPDF_TEXTPAGE handle or IntPtr.Zero on failure. Caller must close with FPDFText_ClosePage.

functions.name: FPDFText_ClosePage
functions.marshalingNotes: Closes text page and releases resources.

functions.name: FPDFText_CountChars
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns number of characters on text page.

functions.name: FPDFText_GetText

parameters.name: result
parameters.marshalingNotes: UTF-16LE buffer for extracted text. Size must be (count + 1) * 2 bytes for null terminator.

functions.marshalingNotes: Extracts text as UTF-16LE with null terminator. Returns number of characters extracted (not bytes).

functions.name: FPDFText_FindStart

parameters.name: findwhat
parameters.marshalingNotes: UTF-16LE encoded search string with null terminator. Must encode as byte array.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.marshalingNotes: Character index to start search from.

functions.marshalingNotes: Starts text search. Returns FPDF_SCHHANDLE or IntPtr.Zero on failure. Caller must close with FPDFText_FindClose.

functions.name: FPDFText_FindNext
functions.marshalingNotes: Searches for next occurrence. Returns true if found, false otherwise.

functions.name: FPDFText_FindClose
functions.marshalingNotes: Closes search handle and releases resources.

functions.name: FPDFAnnot_GetAttachmentPoints

parameters.name: quad_points
parameters.marshalingNotes: Pointer to FS_QUADPOINTSF struct (8 floats). Marshal as ref FS_QUADPOINTSF or pass pre-allocated struct pointer.

functions.marshalingNotes: Gets annotation quad points. Returns true on success, false on failure. FS_QUADPOINTSF is 8 floats (x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4).

functions.name: FPDFAnnot_SetAttachmentPoints

parameters.name: quad_index
parameters.marshalingNotes: Index of quad point set to modify (zero-based).

parameters.name: quad_points
parameters.marshalingNotes: Pointer to FS_QUADPOINTSF struct (8 floats). Marshal as ref FS_QUADPOINTSF.

functions.marshalingNotes: Sets annotation quad points. Returns true on success, false on failure.

functions.name: FPDFAnnot_GetRect

parameters.name: rect
parameters.marshalingNotes: Pointer to FS_RECTF struct (4 floats: left, top, right, bottom). Marshal as ref FS_RECTF or out FS_RECTF.

functions.marshalingNotes: Gets annotation bounding rectangle. Returns true on success, false on failure.

functions.name: FPDF_GetLastError
functions.marshalingNotes: Returns last error code from PDFium operations. Common codes: FPDF_ERR_SUCCESS (0), FPDF_ERR_FILE (1), FPDF_ERR_FORMAT (2), FPDF_ERR_PASSWORD (3), FPDF_ERR_SECURITY (4), FPDF_ERR_PAGE (5).
